name: Handyman
desc: Tech drives all progress. Handymen earn respect through exceptional talent, becoming indispensable pillars of their towns. They accelerate resource acquisition efficiency while providing enhancements to allies.

name: Legion Commander
desc: Before absolute power, all other voices fade into insignificance. A formidable commander will sweep aside all obstacles and conquer all directions. Commanders strengthen troop combat effectiveness while employing tactics to amplify damage dealt to enemies.
